rows.description: Family boasts about you to relatives, and you feel both warm and pressured. Enjoy their pride, but set expectations honestly, since success can vanish. Their love should not depend on the title.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, fear, gratitude, manipulation
related mind states: affection, pride

rows.description: People praise you suddenly and ask for favours. Notice the pattern, thank them, and check whether they were around before. Keep truthful friends who can tell you when you are wrong.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, fear, gratitude, pride
related mind states: gratitude

rows.description: Success brings impostor feelings and fear of being found out. Recognise that many capable people feel it. Keep a record of achievements, ask for feedback, and continue learning without pretending to know everything.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, gratitude, manipulation, pride
related mind states: fear

rows.description: You lose a bid and feel envy at the rival's win. Ask what they did better: price, trust, service. Study and improve. Public sneering or bad-mouthing them harms your own credibility.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: fear, hatred, respect, rivalry
related mind states: envy, trust

rows.description: A competitor consistently delivers well, and you admit it. Respect is strategic: learn from them, compete fairly, and perhaps collaborate where interests align. Respect does not mean giving up.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, fear, hatred, rivalry
related mind states: admiration, interest

rows.description: Your smaller firm fears a bigger competitor's tactics. Focus on niches and customer relationships where you are better, and protect key clients and staff. Fear can push improvement, but must not push unethical shortcuts.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, hatred, respect, rivalry
related mind states: fear

rows.description: A biased or unfair decision seems immovable. Document, look for allies and formal routes such as HR, unions, labour authorities, or lawyers, and decide what fight you can afford. Choosing not to fight can also be wise.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger

rows.description: A coworker is treated unfairly, and you speak up or support them. Solidarity carries risk, so do it with facts and allies. Silence teaches everyone that injustice is normal.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger
paired view exists: Receiver (S2056)

rows.description: A coworker stands by you when you are treated unfairly. Thank them, protect them from consequences where you can, and remember the debt. Such support often makes the difference between giving up and continuing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger
paired view exists: Actor (S2055)
related mind states: gratitude

rows.description: You feel thanks for daily blessings, hard times survived, and those who helped. Let gratitude show as generosity and humility. Devotion without kindness to people around you is incomplete.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, worship
related mind states: gratitude
